title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require stronger guarantees that their data keys are never used outside a pinned region and that RBAC v2 policies are audited end-to-end. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at the RBAC policy evaluation layer and improves audit logging around key selection and fallback decisions.

Summary of changes: 
- Add enforcement in RBAC v2 evaluator to reject cross-region KMS key usage when a policy contains kms_region_pin constraints.
- Emit structured audit events whenever a KMS selection is made, including candidate list, matched policy, and decision (allowed/rejected/fallback). Events include stable fields for region, key_id (hashed), principal, resource, and policy_id.
- Update API-level validation to surface helpful error messages when region constraints block an operation.
- Add a migration that marks existing tenant policies with inferred region residency if their keys already have region tags; this keeps behavior stable for most customers but requires an explicit opt-in to loosen constraints.
- Add 14 new unit/integration tests and 2 e2e policy tests that exercise region pinning + audit sink.
- Docs: update RBAC v2 spec and admin troubleshooting guide with examples and recommended remediation steps.

Backward compatibility & migration: 
- Default behavior is non-breaking: policies without kms_region_pin remain unchanged. The migration only annotates policies; it does not change enforcement without explicit policy edits. Admins will see a notice in the console prompting review.
- For Dedicated/Private deployments: configuration flag `rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning` (default: false for on-prem upgrades) is introduced so operators can enable enforcement on their cadence. Hosted customers will have the flag enabled per security rollout schedule.

Testing & verification: 
- Extensive unit tests for policy evaluation logic and audit event formation.
- Integration tests against the KMS emulator validate region matching and fallback handling.
- Manual QA run in staging to validate console messaging and migration job.

Rollout plan: 
- Step 1 (staged): ship audit-only mode (already covered by earlier PRs) to collect signals for 2 weeks.
- Step 2: enable enforcement for hosted customers behind a feature flag; monitor policy rejection rate and CX.
- Step 3: provide tenant-level opt-out window (30 days) and console prompts to remediate.

Notes for reviewers: 
- Key files include the RBAC evaluator changes, audit event schema, migration job, and console UI copy.
- I ran the migration locally against a snapshot of prod policies; see migration notes in the commits.
- SEC-998 tracks the audit requirements and compliance tests tied to this work.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation
- [x] Unit & integration tests
- [x] Migration script + dry-run logs
- [x] Updated docs
- [x] QA run in staging

review_conversation: Diego Navarro (reviewer): Can you expand on why we need to hash key_id in audit events instead of storing the raw id?

Asha Patel (author): We hash key IDs with a tenant-scoped salt to avoid leaking raw key identifiers into downstream audit sinks while preserving the ability to correlate events within a tenant. Added rationale to audit producer comments.
Priya Kulkarni (reviewer): Integration tests look good; please add a test for fallback behavior when primary key is unreachable (network error) and policy has strict pinning.

Asha Patel (author): Added test 'TestKMSSelector_Fallback_OnNetworkError' and updated selector to emit 'fallback' decision in audit events. CI fixed the flakiness by increasing the emulator backoff timeout.
Omar Schmidt (approver): Verified migration dry-run against snapshot; LGTM. Please ensure feature flag gating is documented for Private installs.
Asha Patel (author): Added config flag docs and default behavior note for Private deployments.
release_notes: Enforce optional KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 policies and emit richer audit events for KMS selection decisions. Admins should review newly annotated policies and enable enforcement per their compliance needs. See docs/admin/kms_region_pinning.md for remediation steps.
notes: This PR is part of the SEC-998 initiative. Hosted rollout will be phased; Private/Dedicated operators should review the config flag before upgrading.
